full_prompt_en: A square humorous watercolor and ink illustration shows a lanky man, a young girl, and three dogs resting beside an old steam locomotive. The man sits at the left on a pile of rough timber, wearing a battered tall dark hat, an open pale shirt, suspenders, loose green trousers, and large brown boots. His long angular face and hooked nose point toward the child. At his right, the girl in an orange dress sits close to his shoulder, her wide eyes looking outward beneath bright yellow hair tied with an oversized red bow. Two black and white dogs sit in the foreground, one near the man's boots and the other at the far right, while a smaller brown dog peeks between the people. Behind them, the gray locomotive's round front and metal pipes climb the left background; a tall black smokestack at the right releases a dark plume that curls into the pale blue gray sky. The ground is a scribble of rails, gravel, and worn wooden ties. The figures occupy the lower half, leaving the machinery as a loose sketchy backdrop rather than a rigidly detailed machine study. Black ink contours vary from thin scratchy marks to thick comic accents, and muted green, ocher, charcoal, and slate blue washes remain partly transparent. Diffuse daylight touches faces and pale shirt fabric, while dark hatching gathers below the train and timber. The whole image feels lively and affectionate, its exaggerated expressions and messy linework making a quiet pause feel like part of a larger adventure.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形幽默水彩墨线插画描绘一名瘦高男子、一个小女孩和三只狗靠在老蒸汽机车旁休息。男子坐在左侧一堆粗木料上，戴破旧的深色高帽，穿敞开的浅色衬衫、背带、宽松绿长裤和大棕靴。修长棱角脸和鹰钩鼻朝向孩子。他右边，女孩穿橙色裙子紧挨肩头，宽睁的眼睛向外看，鲜黄头发上扎着夸张的红色蝴蝶结。两只黑白小狗坐在前景，一只靠近男子靴子，另一只在最右边；更小的棕狗从两人之间探出头。身后，灰色机车的圆形前部和金属管道在左侧背景升起；右侧高黑烟囱放出深色烟羽，卷进浅蓝灰天空。地面由轨道、碎石和磨旧枕木的杂乱线条组成。人物占据下半部，机器成为松散速写背景，而非僵硬精密的机械研究。黑墨轮廓从细刮线变化到厚重漫画重音，低饱和绿、赭黄、炭灰和石板蓝洗色部分保持通透。漫射日光碰到脸和浅色衬衫，深排线聚在火车和木料下方。整体活泼而亲切，夸张神情和纷乱线条让安静停顿像一场更大冒险的片段。
style_prompt_en: Humorous watercolor and ink illustration combines elastic caricature drawing with loose transparent washes. Long angular silhouettes, rounded compact counterforms, and a few exaggerated accents create a playful rhythm. Contours alternate between wiry scratch lines and thicker decisive black marks; hatching clusters around joints, worn surfaces, and recesses. Muted sage green, ocher, rust orange, slate blue, and charcoal supply most of the color, with one small vivid red note. The composition keeps a dense near cluster against a wider sketchy backdrop, leaving paper white visible at the outer edges. Technical forms are suggested through overlapping circles, rods, and verticals rather than rigid mechanical finish. Daylight is broad and even, lifting pale areas while the underside retains rough ink shadow. The result feels energetic, affectionate, and improvisational, with expressive shape design grounded in textured observation.
style_prompt_zh: 幽默水彩墨线插画把富弹性的漫画式造型与松散透明洗色结合。修长棱角剪影、圆润紧凑的对应形体和少数夸张重音创造活跃节奏。轮廓在细如铁丝的刮线和更厚更果断的黑痕之间交替；排线聚在接缝、磨损表面与凹处。低饱和鼠尾草绿、赭黄、锈橙、石板蓝和炭灰提供大部分颜色，另有一处鲜红小重音。构图把密集近景形体群放在更宽阔的速写背景前，外缘露出纸白。技术性形体由重叠圆、直杆和竖线暗示，而不作僵硬机械细描。日光宽广均匀，抬亮浅色区域，让下侧保留粗粝墨影。整体活跃、亲切且有即兴感，富于表情的形状设计由有肌理的观察扎根。
theme_en: A lanky man and a child resting with dogs beside a steam locomotive
theme_zh: 瘦高男子与孩子带着小狗在蒸汽机车旁休息
name: Doug Marlette
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
